name: 作業と工数を揃える表行
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Correct ONLY these visible errors in image1, using ORIGINAL image2 as the exact geometry and icon authority. Keep the existing Japanese task text「礼拝の資料を準備する」and assignee「山田 花子」, white ordinary surfaces, seven-column table state.
1. Put the small thin checkmark INSIDE the outlined completion circle immediately before the task title. Original is a circular outline with checkmark, not an empty radio button.
2. After task title show exactly: numeral1, blue thumbs-up, numeral2, source relationship glyph. Remove the EXTRA numeral1 currently between the thumbs-up and numeral2. Only TWO counters: 1 and2.
3. Restore the missing vertical divider between assignee and due-date calendar. There must be seven separate cells. At logical width1188, vertical divider x positions are522,636,750,882,996,1109. At current enlarged image width scale proportionally. Assignee entirely in cell2; dashed-circle calendar entirely in cell3, aligned8px after its left divider as original. Cells4–7 empty.
4. Restore source fine optical size: completion circle and avatar about20 logical pixels, not oversized; metadata about12px, title Regular14px. Keep all baseline alignment and thin strokes.
Do not change any Japanese wording. Preserve original source disclosure triangle, connected-node relationship glyph, calendar dashed enclosure. No new content, no extra rows, no table header, no date text, no mint/gray panels, no bold. Reduce outside whitespace if the output format permits without changing row geometry.
reviewNotes: 訂正で円内チェック、カウンター1/2、7列の区切りを復元。担当者列が原本比で広く、後続列比にもずれがあるため微細形状・列境界を追加修正。白い外側余白も残る。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
